description: This Java source file contains integration tests for the scheduler jobs in the Apache Fineract project. The tests verify the outcomes of various scheduled operations such as applying fees, interest posting, transferring fees, applying holidays, applying penalties, updating account balances, and loan cash-based operations. The class extends an integration test base and makes extensive use of helper classes to set up data, execute jobs, and verify results across savings accounts, loans, charges, and accounting entries.

classes.name: SchedulerJobsTestResults
classes.description: Integration test class for verifying outcomes of scheduled jobs in the Fineract system.

methods.name: beforeAll
methods.description: Static setup to initialize business step configurations to prevent conflicts during tests.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Prepares the test environment, including initializing REST requests, creating helpers, and setting default configurations.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets configurations to default after each test run.

methods.name: testApplyAnnualFeeForSavingsJobOutcome
methods.description: Tests that the annual fee application job correctly updates the savings account with the next due date.

methods.name: testInterestPostingForSavingsJobOutcome
methods.description: Verifies that the interest posting scheduler correctly updates the savings account balance.

methods.name: testTransferFeeForLoansFromSavingsJobOutcome
methods.description: Checks that the transfer fee deduction from savings accounts for loans works as expected after the job runs.

methods.name: testApplyHolidaysToLoansJobOutcome
methods.description: Ensures that holidays are correctly applied to loan repayment schedules, rescheduling periods accordingly.

methods.name: testApplyType1HolidaysToLoansJobOutcome
methods.description: Tests the application of type 1 holiday adjustments to loan repayment periods.

methods.name: testApplyDueFeeChargesForSavingsJobOutcome
methods.description: Validates that due fee charges are properly deducted from savings accounts during scheduled jobs.

methods.name: testUpdateAccountingRunningBalancesJobOutcome
methods.description: Verifies that the account's running balance is updated correctly after the scheduler runs.

methods.name: testUpdateLoanArrearsAgingJobOutcome
methods.description: Checks that loan arrears aging information is updated appropriately after the job runs.

methods.name: testExecuteStandingInstructionsJobOutcome
methods.description: Ensures standing instructions are executed and balances are adjusted as expected.

methods.name: testApplyPenaltyForOverdueLoansJobOutcome
methods.description: Verifies that overdue loan penalties are correctly applied after the scheduled job execution.

methods.name: testApplyPenaltyForOverdueLoansJobOutcomeIfLoanChargedOff
methods.description: Tests that penalties are not applied or handled correctly when loans are charged off.

methods.name: testLoanCOBJobOutcome
methods.description: Checks the correct application of the loan cash-based operations (COB) after scheduled jobs.

methods.name: testLoanCOBJobOutcomeWhileAddingFeeOnDisbursementDate
methods.description: Verifies that fee accruals and journal entries are properly processed when adding fees on disbursal date.

methods.name: testLoanCOBRunsOnlyOnLoansOneDayBehind
methods.description: Ensures that COB processes only operate on the loans within a one-day delay window.

methods.name: testLoanCOBApplyPenaltyOnDue
methods.description: Validates application of penalties to overdue loans as of the due date after COB runs.
